dependencies: Node >=24, sesh-stork 1.1.0, explicit installed Codex executable and native app-server. Only explicitly authorized activate performs model inference; other operations do not.

operations.check: Validate exact local verb registry and package scripts; no harness access.
operations.preflight: Read one explicit bounded source tape/header and hash, validate explicit new-ID standalone disposition and source quiescence assertion; read-only.
operations.prepare: Pre-migration native fork from explicit preserved tape into destination home. New native ID; source unchanged. SQLite current-operation ledger and immutable source snapshot under explicit new evidence directory.
operations.repair: Post-migration alternative: new native fork of a quiescent current session; no same-ID source conversion. Original chat unchanged. Require explicit new-ID acceptance and fresh external quiescence assertion.
operations.verify: Read native thread and exact-title listing with interactive source filter, no model turn. Protocol acceptance only; desktop/sidebar acceptance remains independent.
operations.schema: Generate the installed Codex protocol schema into one explicitly new directory; no harness session access.
operations.qualify: Synthetic end-to-end pre/post delivery through installed package entrypoints and explicit Codex executable. New isolated test home under exact new output; no model inference, real sessions or credentials. Record current machine results in SQLite.
operations.package: Pack beaver and sibling stork, install complete closure in new isolated prefix with scripts disabled, run installed registry and synthetic delivery qualification; no default runtime/PATH promotion.
operations.status: Read the single current-operation row in one explicit evidence SQLite file; no history scan or mutation.
operations.inspect: Read/hash one exact <=2GiB source tape, native thread metadata and latest completed native turn ID only; no transcript body scan, credentials or model inference.
operations.diagnose: Read one exact thread row from explicit home's state_5.sqlite with an allowlist of classification/listing columns; read-only, no transcript or credential fields.
operations.activate: One explicitly authorized minimal commissioning turn on an already recorded fork, model required, read-only/no-network sandbox and environments disabled. Retain delegated turn attribution; never rewrite index/tape. Record current result in existing operation ledger, then recheck listing/name search. No original-session work or role reassignment.
operations.accept: Reconcile one exact externally observed desktop listing result and bounded instruction-delivery audit into current SQLite operation state; no native session mutation. API listing acceptance is distinct from rendered sidebar/search acceptance.
operations.format: Development-only: install locked scripts formatter dependencies with lifecycle scripts disabled and format only the new beaver/stork CJS source/tests in the owned worktree. No runtime/PATH promotion.
operations.cleanup: Retire explicit synthetic qualification/test-home trees only after exact ownership/physical path/link checks and consistent SQLite backup with digest. Preserve operation ledgers/snapshots outside test homes; no live/default/source homes accepted.

enforcement: Package dispatcher rejects unknown verbs and mismatched registered npm scripts before operation. This is scoped enforcement, not a fleet-wide installed validator.
limits: No supported same-ID source conversion established; no direct live SQLite/tape edits; no native archive/delete rollback because those cascade to descendants. Source is preserved for rollback by choosing original identity. New fork may depend on source lineage; never remove its base. Quiescence assertion is external coordination evidence, not an OS writer lock.
